$comment: The real remaining work on this tree, and which poteto-mode playbook each item routes to.
Not a generated scan. Every item below is something a human or a review actually found and
nobody has done yet, so an empty backlog means finished rather than unscanned -- the
distinction `autofix`'s 86-issue generated list does not make.
`routes_to` is a file under ~/.claude/skills/poteto-mode/playbooks/. Three playbooks are
banned in this repo (autopilot-full, autopilot-stack, autonomous-run): they require the
metacognition Stop hook to be raised or disabled, and that hook caught six false greens in a
day. scripts/improve/route.py refuses to emit them.
`needs_human` marks what an agent must not decide alone. Deleting source, changing a
deployment origin, and touching the user's own transcripts are not an agent's call.

items.title: Loudness normalization never runs on imported files
items.detail: ffmpeg::normalize has one call site, the record-finish path. The settings copy now says so, which made the UI honest but did not add the behaviour. Whisper inventing boilerplate on quiet audio is the failure this would prevent, and imports are where long quiet audio arrives.
items.blocked_by: interacts with the non-speech trim and the ScratchFile guard in cmd/transcribe.rs; needs a design pass before code

items.title: The degenerate-repetition measure cannot gate anything in CI
items.detail: The measure separates cleanly (runs of 6/16/19 against 0) and its self-test is wired into the loop. What it has no corpus for is CI: the only transcripts are the user's own projects folder, and there are no committed audio fixtures to run the engine over.

items.title: verify-vibe's feature map covers none of six surfaces that have defects
items.detail: Nothing in .claude/skills/verify-vibe/features/ covers dictation, meeting detection, the AI summary path, the local API server, model download, recording or settings. Six of those carried a severity-1 or severity-2 defect. The map's own principle -- that proving one entry point leaves the others unproven -- applies to the map.

items.title: The phone credential shares an origin with every page on that host
items.detail: localStorage is partitioned by origin, not path, and the default deployment is thewh1teagle.github.io/vibe/phone/. VIBE_PWA_ORIGIN already supports serving from a dedicated origin. Documented at the storage site and in handoff/README.md; not fixable in the PWA.
items.human_decides: whether to stand up a dedicated origin for the PWA

items.title: .server-version describes a baseline the shipped sidecar is not
items.detail: It says v0.6.10 while binaries/ holds a local build carrying the whisper-rs rolling-context patch and the HTTP Origin guard. Neither reaches a user without a server release. The two strings greps in CLAUDE.md prove what is staged; nothing proves what is released.
items.human_decides: when to cut a server release carrying both patches
